# Loan Origination Ontology Fixture

The Loan Origination Platform depends on KYC Screening Service before an application can move to underwriting.

The KYC Screening Service produces a Customer Risk Assessment event and consumes Customer Profile Data from the onboarding data store.

A new relation label, powers, appears in source material as a reviewable candidate and should not be silently promoted.

The Loan Product is regulated by the KYC Obligation under the Financial Services ontology pack.
